 The North-Easterlies are back! 
 October 20, 2026 October 20, 2026 
 Arshad 
 0 Comments 
 With the return of the North-Easterlies, the rains that were previously making an offshore appearance are now making and inland apperance, bringing more spells of rainfall across North Tamil Nadu and adjoining South Andhra Pradesh.
 THE WIND PATTERN IS BEAUTIFULLY STREAMLINED! 
 UAC started doing its magic as now it’s in the Open Sea breathing happily and freely with the support of Warm waters in Bay .
 As a result of above we can see lot of Butterflies like pop ups in the Bay of Bengal especially near North Tamilnadu and South Andhra Pradesh off coast
 🌧️ WHAT’S NEXT? 
 From here on, we could see an increase in: 
 ✨ Convective pop-up activity
🌧️ Frequency of rainfall spells
⛈️ Rainfall intensity
 Rainfall activity could gradually intensify, with precipitation potentially peaking from tonight through Thursday with gaps between the spells
